fusions.name: Tail Dropped and Thrown
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Flings a shed tail tip that deals 8 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Hiss
fusions.desc: A sudden hiss across the 3 tiles ahead of you deals 12 frost damage to everything in the cone and knocks each target back 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sunning on the Rock
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Blood at Noon
fusions.desc: During the day, you deal 12% more damage.
